title: fleet.restore input
description: One governed fleet-host restore. `host` names one declared fleet host; the daemon uncordons every enabled registry node of the host through its kube surface and reports the real post-patch scheduler state. Omit approvalId on the first call to request operator approval; retry with the exact approved host.

host.description: The declared fleet host to restore.

approvalId.description: The consumed operator approval binding this retry to the approved restore.
